title: Econometric research audit
status: Frozen independent numerical/proof blueprint proposal; no manuscript, checker or acceptance claim.
canonical_scope: Complete original synthetic six-case audit dossier for a future graduate chapter, with twelve suggested fully solved exercise types. Authoring requires the coordinator’s separate exact contract.

independent_confirmation.status: All preliminary numerical anchors and additional contracts confirmed.
methods: Complete enumeration of the 36 balanced assignments, regenerating outcomes from the original potential table for design moments.
Independent indicator inclusion/covariance algebra and finite stratum sample variances.
Row-level cents and explicit record multiplicities for each join/target branch.
A separate fixed-observed-outcome sharp-zero orbit, full selected-direction replay and tie-group calibration.
Explicit finite joint uniform-person/whole-assignment expectations for participation weights, without iid sampling.
Linear-functional extrema and constructive endpoint/mixture arguments for transport limits.
Affine absolute-comparison breakpoints, exact class counts and exhaustive verification of all 1201 integer-cent completions.
independent_confirmation.not_used: No saved root result or implementation was imported as the numerical oracle. Read-only preliminary outputs were used only as comparison targets after reconstructing the finite laws. No source empirical study was reproduced.
additional_confirmed_anchors: Sharp-null orbit variance 21/4 differs from alternative-law variance 25/12.
Observed target-weighted Neyman variance 37/32 has mean 185/48 under the original assignment law.
Effect-only target level shifts yield 25/8 and 45/8.
Restricted p values occur with grid counts 1,100,100,200,800.

original_study_contract.label: Harbor short-course audit dossier — entirely fictional teaching data.
original_study_contract.unit_and_timing: A fixed person is the statistical unit. A is receipt of one well-defined standardized short course with stipulated full compliance; Y is the common four-week earnings outcome in synthetic currency units. The observed input table stores integer cents. No interference and no direct effect of trial participation apart from treatment are stipulated for the intended causal interpretation.
original_study_contract.randomness: Only the complete balanced assignment vector is randomized for the trial estimator. Two stratum selections are independent; assignments within each stratum are dependent. All 36 vectors have probability 1/36.

information_partition.analyst_observed: Trial IDs, baseline X, assigned A and exactly one followup outcome per trial unit; the full frame’s S and X; auxiliary note rows and pipeline logs.
information_partition.teaching_only: All eight pairs of potential outcomes and the stated target counterfactual cell means. These are visibly labeled synthetic oracle inputs for checking method properties, not observed empirical evidence.
information_partition.target_assumption: Original 24 target members comprise 6 low-X and 18 high-X. For the baseline teaching law, each low-X target member has potential outcomes (5/2,7/2) and each high-X target member has (5,8). Their mean equality with the trial cells is a stated substantive construction, not learned from target outcomes.
information_partition.restricted_variant: This is a separate access-world variant with a different auditor. Available evidence consists only of the seven retained observed outcomes, all eight IDs, baseline strata and assignments, the integer bound 0 <= y8_cents <= 1200, and the withheld status. The teaching-only potential-outcome table, its original effect schedule and target counterfactual means, the earlier disclosure y8 = 11 CU, and all earlier full-data statistics or report numbers are explicitly excluded. Candidate completions need satisfy only this variant’s retained records and stated bounds; they need not preserve the complete dossier’s hidden oracle values. A run-log skeleton may retain branch definitions and timing, but must not disclose earlier numeric results from which the withheld amount could be recovered.

original_study_contract.joint_finite_frame_law: Conceptual I is uniform over 32 fixed persons and independent of Z in the 36-assignment design. This defines one-person conditional probabilities and means while preserving dependence among all trial assignments. It is not an iid 32-person observation model.

proof_routes.route: Use D_i inclusion 1/2, within-stratum pair inclusion 1/6 and cross-stratum pair inclusion 1/4. Thus same-stratum assignment covariance is -1/12 and cross-stratum covariance 0. Under stratum-constant additive tau_x, delta_hat_x=tau_x+sum_i(D_i-1/2)b_i. Its variance is the finite control sample variance S_b,x². Weighted independent strata give the trial 25/12 and target 185/48 variances. Derive sample-variance unbiasedness by averaging two-person subsets or invoke the already proved finite-population identity, then show the mean Neyman estimate equals the true variance here because within-stratum effects are constant.
proof_routes.limits: Randomization, not iid person sampling, drives these variances. The observed 5/8 is a random unbiased variance estimator in this specific design, not a coding error and not a proof of exact normal studentization. General within-stratum heterogeneous-effect Neyman variance is conservative unless its missing covariance term is supplied.

proof_routes.route: For any fixed score on a finite assignment space, order its distinct extremeness values and group all ties. The p-value at a group is the probability mass of that group and all more extreme groups. At any threshold alpha, the included top groups have total mass at most alpha. Apply this to |T| under the sharp-zero law, which keeps all eight observed outcomes fixed. The complement assignment has equal probability and statistic -T, so any nonzero observed |T| has at least two included assignments. At T=0 all 36 are included.
proof_routes.limits: The test addresses Y_i(1)=Y_i(0) for every trial unit. A weak zero-average effect does not reveal the missing outcomes and does not justify the same fixed-outcome permutation reference. With this unrandomized inclusive two-sided rule, minimum p=1/18 exceeds 0.05; auxiliary randomized tie-breaking is outside the proposed plan.

proof_routes.route: Define selected direction as positive for T>=0 and negative for T<0. Its raw p is the corresponding inclusive one-sided tail on the fixed null orbit. Replay this selection at every assignment, then calibrate small selected p values against their full randomization distribution. Complement symmetry makes the calibrated result equal the two-sided absolute-statistic p, with truncation at 1 for the zero tie. The unadjusted selected rule rejects the two unique +/-5 extremes at 5 percent: size 2/36=1/18, greater than 1/20.
proof_routes.limits: A future timestamp does not make a result-informed choice prospective. The selection rule uses the correct eight-row primary branch, not the duplicate-join statistic.

proof_routes.route: Fix the 32-person roster and introduce only a conceptual independent uniform person index I. Independently draw the entire balanced treatment vector Z from 36 possibilities. Expectations for a randomly selected person are over this finite (I,Z) law; data-level variance remains over Z alone. The frame masses give p(x), and balanced treatment gives e_a(x)=1/2. Under consistency, no interference/direct participation effect, and equality of each target/trial potential-outcome cell mean, conditional expectation cancels p and e in E[S 1(A=a)Y(1-p)/(p e)]/P(S=0). Summing two cells gives target means. In the finite dataset use sum of treatment-specific weighted outcomes divided by 24; here, and only because of fixed balanced counts, both treatment-specific weight sums also equal 24.
proof_routes.limits: Treatment randomization does not establish participation mean exchangeability. Weight totals and agreement of fixed and ratio denominators do not prove transportability. Pooled frame X weights answer a different target.

proof_routes.claim: Effect-only transport, shifts and unsupported cells
proof_routes.route: A common shift to both target potential means preserves each cell effect but changes the two target levels; calculate the specified kappa example. For the rectangular effect-shift mean model, minimize/maximize the positive-weight linear functional at its corners and interpolate to establish sharpness. For the separate target with one unsupported cell, the known supported effect contribution is 2 and the unknown cell effect lies in [-12,12]; multiplying by 1/5 gives [-2/5,22/5]. Construct the endpoints with potential pairs (12,0) and (0,12), and mixtures of these endpoint pairs for intermediate means.
proof_routes.limits: The shift sets refer to population cell means, not a confidence interval around the observed estimate 6. The unsupported-cell variant is a distinct finite-support target law with its specified X masses, not a relabeling of the original 32-person frame. No trial observation identifies the new-cell effect.

proof_routes.claim: Sharp missing-input statistic set and exact p partition
proof_routes.route: Let k be the unknown integer cents for unit 8, k=0,...,1200. The correctly grouped statistic is 9/4+k/400, so its exact completion set is a lattice and its sharp envelope is [9/4,21/4]. For continuous w=k/100, write each orbit statistic as (m+s w)/4, s=+/-1. The observed statistic is (9+w)/4>0. In |m+s w|>=9+w, multiply the inside by s to reduce to |w+ms|>=9+w. Two comparisons hold always; twenty never hold; four hold only at w=0, four through w=1, four through w=2, and two through w=4. This proves every real interval and boundary, then the integer-cent grid inherits the five values.
proof_routes.limits: This is sensitivity of an incompletely reproducible reported statistic, not a causal identified set or confidence interval. Completion validity is relative only to the restricted variant’s retained records and bounds, not to the complete dossier’s teaching oracle or previously displayed results, which are excluded from this auditor’s information set. The full-data run cannot be claimed executed; conditional completion calculations are executable without access. All completions fail to reject at 5 percent under the prespecified two-sided rule, but that is not evidence that the null is true.

suggested_exercise_types.type: Specify the finite study law and observational information
suggested_exercise_types.answer_contract: Derive the 36 assignments, actual observed rows, trial truth 2 from the teaching oracle and primary estimate 5. State consistency/no-interference, fixed target and which counterfactuals analysts do not observe.

suggested_exercise_types.type: Audit a raw join and units
suggested_exercise_types.answer_contract: Rebuild core joins in cents; enforce unique primary IDs and valid auxiliary composite keys. Reproduce the two deliberately faulty results 23/4 and 31/6, repair to 5, and explain why repeated identical output proves neither the unit of analysis nor the estimand.

suggested_exercise_types.type: Prove design variance and audit the estimated variance
suggested_exercise_types.answer_contract: Use inclusion covariances or the finite-population identity to derive 25/12, then obtain observed Neyman 5/8 and its randomization expectation 25/12. Explain why the finite statistic has no automatic normal reference.
Enumerate the fixed-outcome sharp-zero orbit, obtain 1/18, establish the tie-inclusive finite p inequality and complement minimum, and distinguish a sharp null from a zero-average null.
Calculate raw selected p = 1/36, full-rule size 1/18 at nominal 1/20 and adjusted p = 1/18. Specify the sign-at-zero convention and explain why the chosen direction must be replayed under the null.

Classify prospective, exploratory and outcome-informed decisions from the run log. Refuse to attach P2’s p-value to P1’s duplicate estimate; identify the evidence needed to establish an information boundary rather than trusting a timestamp alone.

Construct the joint I,Z interpretation, p=(2/5,2/11), inverse odds (3/2,9/2), denominator 24 and the target levels 35/8,55/8 versus sample levels 21/8,69/8. Show why dependent balanced assignments do not permit an iid sampling proof.

suggested_exercise_types.type: Change the target weights and quantify sampling uncertainty
suggested_exercise_types.answer_contract: Derive target-effect randomization variance 185/48, optionally observed Neyman 37/32, and the wrong pooled-frame population/observed effects 19/8 and 23/4. Explain the accidental equality with the unrelated duplicate-join output.

suggested_exercise_types.type: Separate effect transport from level transport
suggested_exercise_types.answer_contract: Apply common shifts (1,-2) to obtain target levels 25/8 and 45/8 but unchanged effect 5/2. Derive and prove sharp the mean-shift effect set [13/8,27/8], distinguishing it from a sampling confidence interval.

suggested_exercise_types.type: Prove bounds under a missing support cell
suggested_exercise_types.answer_contract: For the separate target X masses (1/5,3/5,1/5), derive[-2/5,22/5], give endpoint constructions and explain the failure of inverse odds at the target-only cell.

State the restricted auditor’s information set, explicitly excluding the teaching-only potential-outcome table, earlier y8 = 11 disclosure and prior full-data numeric outputs. Derive the 1,201-point primary-statistic lattice and sharp envelope, zero-imputation 9/4 and complete-case half-stratum 9/2 using only retained records and bounds. Derive all affine comparison breakpoints and exact inclusive p regions; identify the five attainable p-values and the invariant 5 percent nonrejection.

A 12-point rubric awards two points each for trial target/design, raw pipeline/branch integrity, sharp-null/search inference, transport/support limits, executed-versus-unexecuted reproducibility, and a defensible conclusion with concrete next steps. No preferred substantive effect sign is required.

material_design_refinements.finding: With integer raw cents, the restricted primary-statistic completion set is a 1201-point lattice. Calling every real number in the envelope attainable would be incorrect.
material_design_refinements.resolution: Use the exact lattice and call [9/4,21/4] its sharp envelope; the explicitly continuous relaxation fills that interval. Root confirmed this refinement. The five p-value regions are the same under both domains.

material_design_refinements.finding: The duplicate-join estimate and selected-tail p-value arise from distinct pipelines.
material_design_refinements.resolution: Named P0–P4 branch contracts and relative-day run log explicitly prevent attaching P0/P2 inference to P1’s statistic. Root required this separation.

material_design_refinements.finding: One-person finite-frame probabilities could be mistaken for iid sampling or independent assignments.
material_design_refinements.resolution: Define conceptual independent I and whole randomized Z explicitly. Transport expectation is over (I,Z); trial-estimator uncertainty is over the dependent balanced vector Z.

material_design_refinements.finding: True alternative-law estimator variance and sharp-zero reference variance differ.
material_design_refinements.resolution: Keep 25/12 and 21/4 in distinct laws; observed Neyman 5/8 is legitimate but does not supply an exact normal tail. The Fisher p tests sharp zero, not a weak average null.

material_design_refinements.finding: The p-value envelope hides a discrete attainable set and inclusive endpoint behavior.
material_design_refinements.resolution: Record all five exact regions and the comparison-class formula; do not claim all real p values between 1/18 and 4/9 occur.

material_design_refinements.finding: Withholding a value is vacuous if the same auditor can consult its earlier disclosure, the teaching potential-outcome table or full-data outputs that determine it.
material_design_refinements.resolution: Define a separate access-world auditor and expressly exclude those records and numerical disclosures. Every candidate completion uses only retained records and stated bounds and need not preserve the complete dossier’s hidden oracle. This implements the coordinator’s information-boundary clarification without changing any numerical result.
